record.narrative: The twelve new discovery results test serum-stratified main effects, PTEN clean-background serum context, two SMARCA4 context interactions, and three broad predictor screens. Applying the 0.15-unit threshold to signed intervals: H93/R81 estimates KEAP1-loss association in high-serum cells as +0.739 [0.650, 0.828]; H94/R82 estimates the same association in lower-serum cells as +0.912 [0.818, 1.007]. Both are entirely above threshold, so I accept and close these claims. This supports KEAP1-loss association with weaker composite dependency in both measured serum strata; the earlier H92 attenuation signal is not evidence that the KEAP1 effect disappears or falls below threshold in high serum. Likewise, TP53-loss high-serum H95/R83 +0.845 [0.767, 0.923] and lower-serum H96/R84 +0.807 [0.705, 0.908] are wholly above threshold, supporting a TP53-loss weaker-dependency association in both serum contexts. SMARCA4-loss high-serum H97/R85 +0.787 [0.708, 0.866] and lower-serum H98/R86 +0.832 [0.729, 0.934] are also wholly above threshold in the claimed stronger-dependency direction. These six accepted stratum-specific effects reinforce the main predictor findings and do not support serum-condition-specific loss of those associations. PTEN serum interaction in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background H99/R87 is +0.058 [-0.113, 0.229]; it is not evidence of a threshold-level serum modifier. I mark it unresolved but closed because the accepted PTEN association is already conditional on the clean background and this context is not the most informative follow-up. Secondary screens: H75/R88 is -0.120 [-0.266, 0.027], with the claimed-direction upper bound far below threshold and the point estimate leaning opposite the claim, so it is rejected. H76/R89 is +0.100 [-0.024, 0.225], below the threshold point estimate but wide enough to include threshold-level effects and null/opposite effects; it remains unresolved and deferred. H79/R90 NF1-loss is -0.014 [-0.112, 0.083], with upper bound below threshold, so reject. H65/R91 BRAF V600E-loss is +0.030 [-0.082, 0.142]; the claimed upper bound is below threshold, so reject, though it is near threshold. H47/R92 STK11-loss in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background is -0.011 [-0.066, 0.045], clearly supporting no threshold-level stronger-dependency effect; reject and close. Overall, the new results broaden support for the accepted TP53, KEAP1, and SMARCA4 associations across serum strata and close several low-yield context and broad-screen claims. The only unresolved context signal with a point estimate above threshold is H92, the KEAP1 high-serum attenuation interaction (+0.173 [0.044, 0.303]); I request independent validation of H92 because it may refine context dependence, but this validation cannot overturn the already accepted KEAP1 main association or the accepted high/low serum stratum estimates. prompt:
Iteration 7/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative:
Two assessments are due. H67 is the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype-background PTEN-loss claim, tested in the claimed stronger-dependency direction (signed positive estimates). Discovery R54 is signed +0.252 [0.169, 0.335], entirely above the 0.15-unit threshold. Independent validation R66 is signed +0.263 [0.135, 0.392], with a point estimate above threshold and the same direction, but the conservative validation lower bound falls just below threshold. The totality of evidence supports a replicated threshold-level association in the supplied dataset within the clean TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background: the original discovery interval was wholly meaningful, the validation point is concordant and slightly larger, and the only shortfall is a narrowly subthreshold validation lower bound. I therefore maintain H67 as accepted and closed. This should not be expanded into an unqualified full-population PTEN claim; H58 remains unresolved because its independent validation interval is compatible with a smaller subthreshold effect.

H92 tests the opposite-direction serum hypothesis: attenuation of the KEAP1-loss association in media_serum_pct >= 10 relative to lower serum. Discovery R72 is signed +0.173 [0.044, 0.303], with a point estimate above threshold but an interval that includes threshold-level effects as well as smaller effects. Independent validation R93 is signed +0.057 [-0.124, 0.238]. The validation point is far below threshold and compatible with no interaction, while its upper bound still leaves open a possible larger attenuation effect. Together, these results do not support a scientifically meaningful serum attenuation modifier. Because the intervals remain compatible with threshold-level attenuation, I do not accept H92, but I also do not convert the uncertainty into a definitive negative claim. I mark H92 unresolved and close it. Importantly, this does not weaken the accepted KEAP1 main association: high-serum H93/R81 +0.739 [0.650, 0.828] and lower-serum H94/R82 +0.912 [0.818, 1.007] both remain threshold-level, so serum context does not remove the KEAP1-loss association.

Overall scientific conclusions in this supplied dataset remain: TP53 loss is associated with weaker composite dependency (H13/R1+R26; supported across TP53/KEAP1-wildtype background H29 and serum strata H95/H96); KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker composite dependency (H3/R3+R13; supported in high- and lower-serum strata H93/H94); SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger composite dependency (H4/R4+R39, and especially in the TP53/KEAP1-wildtype background H30/R16+R40; also supported across serum strata H97/H98); PTEN loss is associated with stronger composite dependency only in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background (H67/R54+R66). Negative or unsupported findings remain all three research markers, STK11, MTAP, KRAS, ARID1A, ERBB2, MYC, PIK3CA, RB1, APC, SMAD4, BRCA2, NF1, BRAF V600E, Avana-library main effect, and the rejected context interactions. CDKN2A remains borderline unresolved after concordant but threshold-centered discovery and validation estimates, and full-population PTEN remains unresolved because its validation is not wholly above threshold.

The most informative next work is ploidy context, not serum. Several ploidy interactions are unresolved, especially H76 for SMARCA4 loss, with signed discovery +0.100 [-0.024, 0.225]. I registered direct ploidy-stratified main effects for SMARCA4, TP53, and KEAP1. These will distinguish a genuine context-dependent shift from wide interaction uncertainty: if the main association remains wholly above threshold in both ploidy strata for each predictor, that supports ploidy similarity; if a stratum-specific association falls below threshold or changes materially, that will identify which context warrants focused follow-up. All conclusions are associations within the supplied dataset, not causal claims or externally generalizable biological claims.

prompt:
Iteration 8/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

record.narrative: No assessments are due. The main scientific priorities now are to resolve context dependence for the accepted predictors and for the two borderline predictors, rather than to reopen the rejected research markers, serum, broad negative screens, or full-population PTEN claim. The accepted supplied-dataset associations are TP53 loss with weaker composite dependency, KEAP1 loss with weaker composite dependency, SMARCA4 loss with stronger composite dependency, and PTEN loss with stronger composite dependency only within the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background. Ploidy-stratified main effects for TP53, KEAP1, and SMARCA4 are already registered as H100-H105. I now add complementary direct ploidy-stratified PTEN main effects inside the same clean background. These are refinements of the unresolved H90 ploidy interaction. A threshold-level negative raw contrast in both high-ploidy and low-ploidy strata would indicate that the accepted clean-background PTEN association is stable across ploidy. A threshold-level association in only one stratum would identify ploidy as a meaningful supplied-dataset context. I also register direct ploidy-stratified CDKN2A clean-background main effects to determine whether the borderline full-population and clean-background CDKN2A signals are diluted by ploidy heterogeneity or genuinely subthreshold across contexts. The PTEN clean-background lineage-subtype interaction tests whether the accepted PTEN effect is truly stronger in adenocarcinoma than in the complementary subtype group within the clean background. Given H61's very large adenocarcinoma-specific clean-background estimate and the smaller overall clean-background estimate, I expect stronger PTEN association in adenocarcinoma, but the threshold-level interaction is not established. A null would support applying the accepted clean-background PTEN association more broadly within the supplied dataset; a threshold-level opposite-direction interaction would support complement-subtype specificity. For broad coverage, I add MSI-high as a genetically plausible binary predictor, expecting higher genomic instability and possible stronger composite dependency, while acknowledging that immunogenicity or distinct lineage composition could produce no effect or weaker effect. Finally, I add two technical library screens, Ky and Humagne-CD, as dataset-artifact checks. I expect no threshold-level library-specific difference because the Avana-library main effect was rejected and the accepted predictor associations are broadly stable, but a threshold-level difference would indicate technical confounding and would require cautious interpretation of accepted associations. All proposed effects are associations in this supplied dataset, not causal claims or externally generalizable biological claims.

The accepted supplied-dataset associations are TP53-loss weaker dependency, KEAP1-loss weaker dependency, SMARCA4-loss stronger dependency, and PTEN-loss stronger dependency only in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background. Ploidy-stratified main effects for the three accepted broad predictors directly test whether the already large associations remain wholly above the 0.15-unit threshold in both high-ploidy and low-ploidy strata. If so, this supports context stability and allows ploidy lines to be closed; if a stratum-specific association is materially lower or falls below threshold, it identifies where focused refinement or validation is warranted. For PTEN, because the accepted claim is conditional on the clean background, I request clean-background PTEN ploidy main effects rather than another full-population ploidy interaction. These distinguish whether the accepted PTEN association is stable across ploidy or confined to one ploidy stratum. The PTEN clean-background lineage-subtype interaction tests whether the accepted clean-background PTEN effect is meaningfully stronger in adenocarcinoma than in the complementary subtype group; a null would support applying the clean-background PTEN association more broadly within the supplied dataset. For CDKN2A, whose full-population and clean-background estimates remain borderline around the threshold, I request clean-background ploidy-stratified main effects to determine whether borderline uncertainty reflects context heterogeneity rather than a uniform subthreshold effect. I also request a broad MSI-high screen because it is a scientifically plausible genetic-context predictor and would be informative if it exceeds threshold, although a negative result is expected to be consistent with the broad rejection pattern for many genomic alterations. I defer the technical Ky and Humagne-CD library checks to a later cycle because the Avana-library main effect was rejected and technical screening is less likely to change the current accepted predictor conclusions than resolving ploidy and conditional PTEN/CDKN2A context. All requested analyses are discovery estimates; acceptance decisions and any validation will be made after inspecting the resulting interval estimates.

prompt:
Iteration 8/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative:
The new discovery results address ploidy-stratified main effects for the already accepted broad predictors, ploidy-stratified clean-background PTEN effects, clean-background CDKN2A ploidy effects, a PTEN clean-background lineage interaction, and an MSI-high broad screen. Applying the 0.15-unit threshold to the signed intervals: SMARCA4-loss high ploidy is +0.856 [0.767, 0.945] and low ploidy is +0.756 [0.668, 0.843]; TP53-loss high ploidy is +0.887 [0.796, 0.978] and low ploidy is +0.775 [0.690, 0.860]; KEAP1-loss high ploidy is +0.821 [0.719, 0.923] and low ploidy is +0.799 [0.715, 0.884]. All six intervals are wholly above threshold in the claimed direction. I accept and close these ploidy-stratified main effects. This supports robustness of the TP53-loss weaker-dependency, KEAP1-loss weaker-dependency, and SMARCA4-loss stronger-dependency associations across measured ploidy strata. Because direct main-effect strata are strongly threshold-level in both strata, the older ploidy interaction claims H76, H80, and H81 are no longer the most informative lines; I keep them unresolved but close investigation as bookkeeping, not as evidence of meaningful modification.

For PTEN loss within the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background, high ploidy is +0.297 [0.174, 0.419], wholly above threshold, so H106 is accepted. Low ploidy is +0.209 [0.095, 0.324]; the point estimate is above threshold but the interval includes effects below threshold, so H107 remains unresolved. Given the already accepted overall clean-background PTEN association and the accepted high-ploidy stratum, I close this lower-priority low-ploidy stratum line rather than pursue further validation solely for it. The clean-background PTEN lineage-subtype interaction H110/R102 is -0.030 [-0.237, 0.178]. It neither supports nor excludes a threshold-level adenocarcinoma-specific difference, so I leave it unresolved but close investigation.

For clean-background CDKN2A loss in ploidy strata, high ploidy is +0.106 [0.017, 0.195] and low ploidy is +0.155 [0.059, 0.252]. Neither interval is wholly above threshold, and the estimates are near the threshold boundary. I leave both unresolved and close these CDKN2A ploidy follow-ups. CDKN2A therefore remains a borderline unresolved predictor overall, not a stable accepted association within this supplied dataset.

The MSI-high broad screen H111/R105 is +0.775 [0.664, 0.885], far above threshold and entirely on the claimed side. This is a large new supplied-dataset association. Because it emerged after extensive multiplicity and MSI-high is less frequent than the core accepted predictors, I accept the discovery evidence but keep H111 active and request independent validation. If validation is concordant, MSI-high can be treated as a supported supplied-dataset association; if it is unexpectedly weak, I will downgrade it rather than overclaim it. All conclusions remain associations within this supplied dataset and do not imply causality or external generalizability.

Iteration 8/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative:
The new validation strongly supports the MSI-high association and resolves two borderline CDKN2A lines. H111 tests MSI-high versus MSI-stable in the claimed stronger-dependency direction; because the signed interval is already transformed to that direction, positive signed estimates mean MSI-high samples have lower, more negative dependency_composite values. Discovery R105 is +0.775 [0.664, 0.885], and independent validation R106 is +0.888 [0.713, 1.064]. Both are far above the 0.15-unit threshold and wholly on the claimed side. I therefore accept H111 and close it. Within this supplied dataset, MSI-high is now a replicated threshold-level association with stronger composite dependency. This is not a causal claim or an externally generalizable biological claim.

H70 tested CDKN2A-loss association specifically within MTAP-positive samples. Discovery R63 is +0.124 [-0.039, 0.287] and validation R107 is +0.140 [-0.090, 0.370]. Both point estimates are below the 0.15-unit threshold, and both intervals include null, threshold-level positive effects, and larger positive effects. This is not evidence of a threshold-level CDKN2A effect in the MTAP-positive context, but the wide validation interval prevents a clean negative conclusion. I therefore mark H70 unresolved but close further investigation as low priority.

H6 is the full-population CDKN2A-loss claim. Discovery R6 is +0.139 [0.065, 0.213], and independent validation R79 is +0.169 [0.061, 0.276]. The pattern is borderline: the validation point exceeds threshold, but neither discovery nor validation is wholly above threshold, and the discovery point estimate is below threshold. The totality remains uncertain rather than replicated threshold-level. H6 therefore remains unresolved and closed.

H38 is the Avana-library main effect in the claimed positive direction. Discovery R37 is +0.053 [-0.035, 0.141], and independent validation R80 is -0.077 [-0.203, 0.048]. The validation point is even in the opposite direction, and neither interval is wholly above the threshold. This does not support a scientifically meaningful Avana-library main effect, so I maintain reject and close.

Overall supplied-dataset conclusions are now: TP53 loss is associated with weaker composite dependency (H13/R1+R26, replicated and stable across measured contexts including ploidy strata H102/H103 and serum strata H95/H96); KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker composite dependency (H3/R3+R13, stable across ploidy H104/H105 and serum H93/H94); SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger composite dependency (H4/R4+R39, strong in clean TP53/KEAP1 background H30/R16+R40, and stable across ploidy H100/H101 and serum H97/H98); PTEN loss is associated with stronger composite dependency only in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background (H67/R54+R66), and this is not an unqualified full-population PTEN claim; MSI-high is associated with stronger composite dependency (H111/R105+R106). Negative or unsupported findings include the research markers, STK11, MTAP, KRAS, ARID1A, ERBB2, MYC, PIK3CA, RB1, APC, SMAD4, BRCA2, NF1, BRAF, and the Avana-library main effect, plus rejected serum/lineage/Cas9/growth-rate/culture/stemness context modifiers where intervals were clear enough to reject. Unresolved uncertainty remains mainly around CDKN2A, full-population PTEN, EGFR amplification, and pending technical library checks. The most informative next work is to test whether the newly validated MSI-high association is stable in clean TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4 background and across ploidy strata, while retaining Ky and Humagne-CD library checks as low-priority artifact screens.

prompt:
Iteration 9/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Iteration 9/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every

Iteration 9/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

record.narrative:
All eleven due discovery results can now be assessed against the 0.15-unit signed-effect threshold. MSI-high remained far above threshold in every direct context test: clean TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background H114/R108 +0.745 [0.666, 0.825]; high ploidy H115/R109 +0.810 [0.660, 0.961]; low ploidy H116/R110 +0.730 [0.565, 0.895]; adenocarcinoma subtype H117/R111 +0.740 [0.611, 0.869]; high serum H119/R113 +0.748 [0.591, 0.905]; and low serum H120/R114 +0.810 [0.654, 0.967]. I accept and close these context main-effect lines. This supports treating the already validated MSI-high association as stable across these measured supplied-dataset contexts, not merely a consequence of TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4 composition, ploidy, adenocarcinoma-subtype composition, or serum condition. The corresponding lineage-subtype interaction H118/R112 is -0.122 [-0.373, 0.129]; its upper bound is below the 0.15-unit threshold, so the evidence does not support a threshold-level adenocarcinoma-specific modification. I reject that interaction as a meaningful context difference, while noting it does not exclude subthreshold heterogeneity.

H121/R115 tests PTEN loss within the accepted TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background after excluding MSI-high samples. It is +0.260 [0.182, 0.339], wholly above threshold in the claimed stronger-dependency direction. I accept and close it. This makes the accepted conditional PTEN association less likely to be carried by overlap with the much stronger MSI-high association, although it remains a conditional supplied-dataset association. H122/R116 tests EGFR amplification in adenocarcinoma and is +0.027 [-0.095, 0.149], with an upper bound just below threshold and a point estimate near null. I reject the adenocarcinoma-refined EGFR claim and close it; this does not overturn the earlier unresolved full-population EGFR line, but substantially weakens interest in EGFR as a threshold-level predictor in the dominant subtype.

The remaining library artifact checks are negative in the tested direction: Ky H112/R117 -0.061 [-0.129, 0.008] and Humagne-CD H113/R118 -0.057 [-0.185, 0.071]. Their upper bounds are below threshold, so I reject the claimed positive main effects and close these lines. This is consistent with the rejected Avana-library main effect and does not suggest that the accepted core predictor conclusions are driven by large library-main-effect shifts, though residual technical heterogeneity cannot be completely excluded.

I request independent validation for H121 because it is the most consequential newly accepted line for causal-confounding auditing: it tests whether the conditional PTEN-loss association survives exclusion of MSI-high. A concordant validation would strongly support the conditional PTEN conclusion as MSI-independent within this supplied dataset. A weak validation would qualify H121 and the MSI-independence interpretation but would not automatically overturn the broader accepted H67 PTEN claim. All conclusions remain associations within the supplied dataset and do not establish causality or external generalizability.

Iteration 9/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment

This supports the conclusion that the accepted conditional PTEN-loss association is not merely an artifact of overlap with the much stronger MSI-high association, although it remains a conditional supplied-dataset association rather than a broad PTEN claim. For H92, the reversed KEAP1-loss media-serum interaction was threshold-level in discovery, R72 +0.173 [0.044, 0.303], but independent validation R93 was only +0.057 [-0.124, 0.238]. Validation does not refute the discovery finding, but it is not threshold-level and is consistent with a much smaller attenuation. I therefore leave H92 unresolved and close it. The main KEAP1-loss weaker-dependency effect remains accepted in both high-serum and low-serum direct strata; the evidence for a meaningful high-serum attenuation is not stable. Overall supported supplied-dataset conclusions are: TP53 loss is associated with higher, i.e. weaker, composite dependency (replicated, H13/R1+R26); KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency (replicated, H3/R3+R13); SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger, i.e. more negative, composite dependency (replicated, H4/R4+R39); MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency (replicated, H111/R105+R106); and PTEN loss is associated with stronger dependency specifically in the TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype background, with replication after excluding MSI-high (H67/R54+R66 and H121/R115+R119). Remaining unresolved uncertainty includes full-population PTEN, CDKN2A-loss overall and in MTAP or ploidy contexts, full-population EGFR amplification, and the KEAP1 high-serum attenuation line now closed as unresolved. The most informative next work would be broad technical-quality and demographic screening using safe binary variables, such as matched-omics availability, to assess residual measurement confounding, while avoiding further reopening of already well-supported core associations. record.narrative:
No assessments are due. The most valuable next work is to test whether accepted associations depend on basic data-completeness strata and to resolve whether the borderline CDKN2A and PTEN signals are carried by overlap with the very strong MSI-high association. I first register two artifact-sensitivity screens: samples with matched RNA/DNA versus unmatched samples, and samples with RNA-omics availability versus absent. These are technically important because composite dependency estimates may be less stable when omics or matched profiling are incomplete. If either completeness flag is associated with a difference above 0.15 composite dependency-score units, that identifies a technical/measurement context that should qualify broad interpretation of the supplied associations. If both are near threshold, it supports the robustness of existing predictor conclusions to this source of heterogeneity.

I then test the accepted core predictors within complete versus incomplete matched omics strata. For TP53 loss and KEAP1 loss, I expect the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast to remain positive because prior evidence shows both are associated with weaker dependency, meaning higher composite scores. For SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high, I expect the raw contrast to remain negative because both have been associated with stronger dependency, meaning more negative composite scores. For matched=0, the sample is smaller, so a weaker interval is plausible; the scientific question is whether the direction and threshold-level magnitude survive or collapse. Alternatives include: same stable association, attenuation in incomplete data suggesting measurement-quality confounding, or reversal indicating unmeasured population structure. I test MSI-high only in the matched-complete stratum because MSI-high is rare and unmatched cells may be underpowered.

Finally, I address two unresolved predictors by excluding MSI-high. CDKN2A loss remains borderline in the full population: discovery R6 was +0.139 [0.065, 0.213], and validation R79 was +0.169 [0.061, 0.276], both signed toward stronger dependency but not wholly above threshold. Because MSI-high is a strong stronger-dependency association, I test CDKN2A loss among MSI-stable samples. If this becomes wholly above threshold, it would strengthen CDKN2A as an MSI-independent association; if it falls far below, the full-population signal may partly reflect MSI composition or residual context. For PTEN loss, full-population evidence remains unresolved (R48 +0.239 [0.145, 0.332]; R53 +0.195 [0.062, 0.328]), while the accepted clean TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4-wildtype conditional association is robust and replicated after excluding MSI-high. I test PTEN loss among MSI-stable samples without requiring the clean background to see whether a broader PTEN association persists once the dominant MSI-high confounding association is removed. I also test the accepted clean-background, MSI-stable PTEN association within the matched-complete stratum to check whether this replicated conditional PTEN finding is stable against data-completeness differences. All claims are associations within the supplied dataset and do not establish causality or external generalizability.
